problem_statement: Discovery on the theme of MCP header forwarding surfaced a coherent seed but did not cluster any pain points with validated issue evidence, so this PRD is drafted from a thin finding and its user stories could not be grounded.
target_user: Developers configuring MCP servers behind authenticating proxies who expect custom authorization headers to be forwarded during server discovery.

acceptance_criteria.given: an MCP server discovery request with a custom Authorization header
acceptance_criteria.when: the proxy forwards the discovery call
acceptance_criteria.then: the Authorization header is preserved on the forwarded request

acceptance_criteria.when: discovery is attempted without header forwarding
acceptance_criteria.then: the failure surfaces a clear 403-with-cause error rather than a silent empty result

acceptance_criteria.given: an MCP server requiring no auth

success_metrics.name: discovery success rate against auth-protected servers
success_metrics.definition: share of discovery attempts against authenticating MCP servers that complete without a 403

out_of_scope: Header forwarding for non-discovery MCP traffic

risks.description: This PRD rests on a finding with no grounded pain points, so problem framing may be weaker than the seed implies and should be revalidated before build
